_comment: Canon art style + render rules for the card-art pipeline. GAME-AGNOSTIC: nothing here references a specific game. Edit `styleBlock` to re-skin the whole pipeline to a new aesthetic; everything downstream reads from this file.
styleBlock: Bold cartoon-action style with Krooked Glasses Lythero raid-boss thumbnails AS THE FOUNDATION — freeze-frame action poses, dramatic POV, saturated palette. Layered with Genndy Tartakovsky (Samurai Jack, Primal) + Avatar: The Last Airbender + classic Studio Trigger boldness — VERY thick chunky outlines, simplified anatomy with strong gestural shapes, exaggerated cartoon proportions where it serves character (big hands on a fighter, tiny feet on a flighty creature). Limited rendering: think CARTOON not anime portrait. The character is constructed from CHUNKY SIMPLE SHAPES — no busy ornamentation, no buckles-and-belts density, no over-rendered fabric folds. Costumes are bold solid forms with only 1-2 distinguishing accents. Colors are flat punchy saturated, hard-edged cel-shaded with ONE shadow tone and ONE rim accent. Eyes are confident anime-cartoon hybrids — one bold iris highlight, simple lash. Hair is iconic and shape-simple — NOT gravity-defying spikes, NOT density-stacked. The result reads as a confident animated-feature-film character, not a trading-card-game illustration packed with detail.
outlineGuidance: Heavy black inked outlines with variable line weight. Confident, hand-drawn quality, NOT vector-clean. Outline is darker on shadow side, thinner on light side. NO mid-paint soft outlines, NO outlineless flat-cel.
shadingGuidance: Hard-edged cel shading. ONE shadow tone (a multiplied darker version of the base color). ONE rim/accent highlight (a single sharp edge of warm or cool light depending on the scene). NO gradient ramps, NO airbrush soft shading, NO ambient occlusion smoothness. Shadows are decisive shapes, not soft transitions.
referenceFamily: PRIMARY FOUNDATION: Lythero raid-boss YouTube thumbnails by Krooked Glasses — bold cel-shaded action thumbnails with dramatic POV, snarling/grinning central character, oversized weapons/fists at camera, motion lines and impact debris, saturated sunset/neon background gradients framing the figure. SECONDARY FLAVOR: Guilty Gear -STRIVE- and Xrd character key art — extreme line-of-action posing, sharp angular silhouettes with strong negative space, hot-blooded special-move energy, characters readable from silhouette alone. TERTIARY FLAVOR: Yu-Gi-Oh anime card-summon presentation — dramatic upward-low-angle hero shots, top-back-key + bottom-rim spotlight lighting that makes the subject feel summoned-into-frame, expressive manga-style eyes with iris highlight glints. Companion references: Dragon Ball FighterZ splash art, classic Trigger studio key art, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure manga panel finishes.
avoidList: MTG-specific frame elements (mana symbols, card border)
YGO-specific frame elements (level stars, attribute icons, ATK/DEF text)
Hearthstone-specific UI (rope timer, hexagonal portrait frame)
any text, logos, watermarks, or signatures within the image
vector-clean linework (we want hand-drawn confidence, not Illustrator)
identityRefRenderRules: Subject ONLY — NO background, NO scene, NO ground/pedestal/perch.
TRANSPARENT background (alpha = 0 around the subject). Output a true-alpha PNG, NOT a checkerboard painted onto an opaque image.
Subject faces RIGHT or three-quarters right (a renderer can mirror for left-side use).
Centered; subject fills the middle 60-70% of the frame.
Neutral, even lighting (this is the canonical 'what does it look like' reference — dramatic lighting comes later at card-art time).
cardartRenderRules: SINGLE cohesive render (not a composite of character + background) so palette, lighting, and atmosphere are designed together.
Character mid-ACTION, frozen at the most dramatic beat of a signature move — limbs extended, weight shifted, cloth/hair caught in motion. NOT a portrait stance.
Character occupies the middle 55-70% of the frame, placed on a rule-of-thirds vertical (not dead center).
ONE dominant key light with a clear direction; a BRIGHT RIM LIGHT separates the character from the background (the #1 trick to make them pop).
Derive the character palette from the identity-ref image itself; the background uses COMPLEMENTARY tones at LOWER saturation so the character is the loudest element.
Character has sharper linework + harder cel-shading than the (softer/atmospheric) background.

bgArchetypes.description: A flat geometric mosaic/diamond-pattern backdrop in deep cobalt and slate. Simple, graphic, no depth. The character POPS hard off the patterned wall.
A massive solar eclipse dominating the upper half — black disc surrounded by brilliant white-gold corona, deep purple-orange sky. Character silhouetted/backlit by the corona.
A radial energy burst centered behind the character — concentric rings of light, motion lines streaking from center, tinted to the character's accent. The character is the explosive epicenter.
An ornate stained-glass window as the entire backdrop — bold lead lines dividing colored panels, light streaming through, tinted complementary.
A shattered-glass effect frozen mid-break — fractured shards radiating from the character, each refracting a different complementary color.
A swirling vortex/maelstrom rotating around the character — concentric spiral lines, motion blur, character at the calm eye.
A cinematic lens flare from a sun/spotlight at upper-left, hexagonal flare elements, golden warm light bleeding into cool shadow. Blockbuster-poster energy.
Deep space — swirling nebula in the complementary color, distant stars, suggestion of galactic depth. Astral feel.
Pure-black backdrop with one or two intense stage spotlights cutting from above-back, illuminating the character on a circular floor of light. Theatrical/wrestling-ring vibe.
Bold radial rays of color emanating from behind the character (manga sunburst), alternating thick-thin lines in two complementary colors.
A massive cresting wave of the character's signature power filling the background (fire, frost, dust, leaves — match the character), frozen at its dramatic peak.
Dramatic painterly brush-streaks of complementary colors slashing diagonally behind the character — bold, gestural, album-cover energy.
A retro-cyberpunk neon grid receding to a vanishing point on a deep purple-black void. Vaporwave-meets-Tron.
A pure flat field of ONE saturated complementary color — character is the only thing in the frame. Ultra-minimal comic-cover energy.
Towering stormclouds across the backdrop, lightning forks frozen mid-strike behind the character, dramatic backlight.
Glowing embers of the character's accent color filling the frame, motion-blurred upward, deep shadow void behind.
Bold flat geometric color-block composition — overlapping triangles, circles, rectangles in the complementary palette (Bauhaus/graphic-poster).
A collage of torn paper layers behind the character, each a different solid complementary color, slight paper grain. Punk-zine aesthetic.

A FULL ELABORATE PAINTED SCENE that fits THIS character's narrative — pick a SPECIFIC vivid place (moonlit cathedral, desert mesa at sunset, neon rooftop, frozen aurora lake, clockwork tower, bamboo grove, colosseum mid-roar, star-observatory dome...). Render with depth + atmosphere but keep saturation/contrast LOWER than the character so they still pop. This is the variety-injection archetype.
Dense swirling fog tinted complementary, with one bright pool of light from above casting a circle around the character. Atmospheric and moody.
Glowing runes/sigils floating behind the character in a circular pattern, complementary glow. Spellcasting energy.
Deep navy/black starfield with one MASSIVE star bursting behind the character — bright corona, lens flare, scattered stars. Character rim-lit by the burst.
A kaleidoscopic radial pattern of mirrored fragments in complementary colors. Hypnotic and ornate.
Massive translucent crystal formations rising behind the character, refracting light in the accent color. Cool prismatic atmosphere.
Out-of-focus bokeh orbs filling the background (lamps, lanterns, fairy lights) softened into glowing circles. Shallow-DOF; character sharp in foreground.
Black-and-white manga screentone backdrop — halftone dots, hard speed lines from the character. Character stays full-color; bg monochrome-tinted to the accent.
Slow-flowing liquid ribbons (lava, ink, mercury, plasma) cascading across the frame in dramatic curves, tinted to the accent.
A drift of falling elements (cherry petals, autumn leaves, ash, feathers, snow — match the character) caught mid-cascade, character at the stillness in the middle.
One massive single moon (full, crescent, or blood) dominating the upper half — craters detailed, character silhouetted by its glow.
